_note: Crafts (Yusuf, 2026-10-26, replacing single stalls and workshop rows in the draft): a craft is one draft card that adds a workshop and the stall that sells its goods as blueprints together. Their pieces (workshop, stall) never come up in the draft on their own. The market comes with the first craft: until the market is drafted, the draft offers market_crafts of these (data/balance.json) with the market in them, and the player starts with the one they pick. Once the market stands or is drafted, a draft may offer one more craft as its deepening offer. opens = buildings that come up in the draft only once the town has this craft (a founding tradition's buildings are never held back). sim/build_hand.gd (offers, draft_craft), tools/chains.gd draws docs/CHAINS.md from this file.

arms.name: Arms craft
arms.text: A knapper makes blades and spears, and the arms stall sells them to heroes.

hides.name: Hides craft
hides.text: A hide rack works beast hides into armour and cloaks, and the armour stall sells them to heroes.

charms.name: Charms craft
charms.text: A bone carver carves charms, and the charm stall sells them to heroes.

provisions.name: Provisions craft
provisions.text: A smoke hut smokes meat and brews poultices, and the provisions stall sells them to heroes.
